Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.searchRequestFromJson("{\"max_results\":2,\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"Rust programming\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.search(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.results)
```
